decision: Owner decision: declare every condensed kind and every newly named kind for now.
purpose: The error kinds declared in advance of any sample (ASSAYER.md A3). The junction loop may compute only a declared kind as the one blocking an action. Held-back test worlds must be built from kinds NOT in this version.
scope: Condensed from 189 named entries across Minority Prophet and minority-prophet-gate. Research-process errors and refusal codes from retracted modules are not declared here. gate: paths refer to Silentpartnercoding/minority-prophet-gate.
change_rule: This file is versioned. A kind discovered during a run joins only the next version; a version is never edited to cover the run that exposed a gap.

defence_vocabulary.defended: the record itself shows the error and the code refuses or escalates
defence_vocabulary.conditional: defended only when a stated condition holds
defence_vocabulary.bounded: limited by margin, quota or cost, not prevented
defence_vocabulary.undetectable: leaves no mark in the record; only an outside witness or the margin helps
defence_vocabulary.unassessed: newly named; no defence assessed yet

declared.name: Fabrication
declared.what: The world was never consulted: a root backed by nothing real.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable structurally: the graph is never malformed, and the reference check checks shape, not existence. Stopped only where a signature verifier rejects the root.

declared.name: Biased method
declared.what: The method itself is biased.
declared.defenceNote: Caught only by witnesses who re-entered the chain at or below the rung where the error enters.

declared.name: Instrument error
declared.what: Miscalibration or random measurement error.
declared.defenceNote: Caught only by witnesses who re-entered the chain at or below the rung where the error enters.

declared.name: Processing error
declared.what: The pipeline from raw data mangles it.
declared.defenceNote: Caught only by witnesses who re-entered the chain at or below the rung where the error enters.

declared.name: Analysis error
declared.what: Wrong test, arithmetic slip, or coding bug.
declared.defenceNote: Caught only by witnesses who re-entered the chain at or below the rung where the error enters.

declared.name: Transcription error
declared.what: A digit changed on the way to the page.
declared.defenceNote: Caught only by witnesses who re-entered the chain at or below the rung where the error enters.

declared.name: Unrecorded copy
declared.what: A copy with no recorded parent is counted as an independent root.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable by counting: an undetected copy is indistinguishable from an original observation. Bounded only by the R3 margin.
declared.evidence: Demonstrated (Lean CE-01; KL-014 over-count floor at least 0.46 × N)

declared.name: Laundered provenance
declared.what: Faked re-derivation plus scrubbed shared markers remove dependence edges and inflate the count.
declared.defenceNote: Bounded by R3 margin sufficiency rather than solved; no counting rule closes it, only detection does.

declared.name: Fake identities (Sybil)
declared.what: Many fabricated identities, each minting roots.
declared.defenceNote: Bounded by identity cost and the R1.4 issuance quota. At zero identity cost no aggregation rule survives.

declared.name: Stolen signing key
declared.what: One compromised root-signing key issues roots at will.
declared.defenceNote: Bounded by a durable per-window quota that survives restart and key compromise.

declared.name: One observation split into many roots
declared.what: Honest, separate issuers each re-issue the same upstream observation as their own root.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable: no key is compromised, no quota exceeded, no signature invalid, and no quota design fixes it.
declared.evidence: Named in docs, with a pilot

declared.name: Restated or translated copies
declared.what: Paraphrases, translations, summaries and model rewrites are not recognised as copies.
declared.defenceNote: Defended only with supported lineage (HEO-1 added zero evidence-origin roots); not under inferred lineage (holdout accuracy 0.371544).

declared.name: Honest citation of one source
declared.what: Five honest readers of one paper count as five roots.
declared.defenceNote: Defended when the claim names what it read in read_from, which is opt-in and not yet used by shipped callers.

declared.name: One controller posing as many
declared.what: Aliases, rotated keys, split services, or undisclosed common ownership behind apparently separate sources.
declared.defenceNote: Defended with supported controller provenance (HVI-1 admitted zero extra roots). Cannot discover undisclosed common control.

declared.name: Self-verification
declared.what: A producer verifies or mints its own evidence.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: self-verification added zero roots.

declared.name: Shared component or common-mode failure
declared.what: Distinct measurements share one upstream failure cause.
declared.defenceNote: Bounded: much of the gain came through abstention, and HGD-1's primary claim was rejected.

declared.name: A model agreeing with a model
declared.what: One model reviewing another model's output is taken as corroboration.
declared.defenceNote: Defended by rung assignment: it counts as restated text, and is flagged same-control-domain. The assignment is marked contested.

declared.name: Partial dependence
declared.what: Partly correlated observers are treated as either fully independent or fully dependent.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable here: unrepresentable and untheorised.
declared.evidence: Named in code comments and docs

declared.name: Independent roots merged
declared.what: Genuinely independent roots are merged into one, which destroys margin.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable, inside the trusted base: any de-duplication or canonicalisation step is trusted. What is missing is a measurement, not a theorem.

declared.name: Count depends on presentation order
declared.what: An approximate count lets whoever controls the order deflate it.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: exact, or refuse.

declared.name: Chained ancestry collapses the count
declared.what: Treating shared ancestry as an equivalence drives the count toward 1.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: a maximum independent set replaces the quotient.

declared.name: Anonymous witnesses cannot be told apart
declared.what: Collapsing anonymous roots asserts identity; stripping identity deflates the count.
declared.defenceNote: Bounded: the count is reported as a range, and a decision that depends on where in the range the truth lies escalates.

declared.name: Counting at the wrong level
declared.what: Counting at a finer or coarser cut than the decision's failure domain needs.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable by the adapter, which does not infer the cut; sensitivity to alternative cuts is reported.

declared.name: Joint failure domains
declared.what: Two failure domains active at once, which a single cut cannot represent.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable here: multi-cut independence is not implemented.

declared.name: Separate sources repeating one wrong claim
declared.what: Truly separate controllers or origins carry the same wrong claim.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable: supported organisational separation is not proof of causal evidence independence or truth.

declared.name: Universal or existential claim counted as symmetric
declared.what: A claim that one root settles is decided by comparing root counts.
declared.defenceNote: Defended by the separate asymmetric verdict, but the claim shape is declared, not detected: a caller who mislabels a universal claim still gets the wrong answer.

declared.name: Conclusion carried into another vocabulary untested
declared.what: A result established in one ontology is assumed to hold in another, or flips under a change of category scheme.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: an untested transport defaults to UNTESTED, never inherited validity; vocabulary perturbation is probed.

declared.name: Absence without a complete search
declared.what: Absence is concluded from a partial or unknown-coverage search.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: the conclusion is not established, or escalates.

declared.name: Empty search counted as opposition
declared.what: An unsuccessful search is filed as contrary evidence.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable here: the evaluator cannot enforce this.

declared.name: Unattributed claims silently dropped
declared.what: Claims with no root get zero influence, or full influence, without anyone deciding.
declared.defenceNote: Defended by default, and the default is recorded as a policy decision, not a theorem.

declared.name: Stale or expired evidence
declared.what: Evidence past its lifetime, or with no timestamp under a freshness policy.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: blocked, or given zero weight.

declared.name: Revoked, or revocation unknown
declared.what: Evidence or authority has been revoked, or its revocation status cannot be determined.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: revoked blocks; unknown escalates or blocks.

declared.name: Replay
declared.what: The same evidence, nonce or delivery is presented again.
declared.defenceNote: Defended with a durable nonce store; an in-memory set is only a local demonstration.

declared.name: Fresh restatement of an old observation
declared.what: A recent restatement carries the freshness of the restatement, not of the observation it rests on.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable in the profile: a consumer cannot age the root.

declared.name: Evidence bound to the wrong proposition or action
declared.what: Evidence is attached to a different claim, subject, request or action than the one being decided.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: blocked; a missing expected binding escalates.

declared.name: Evidence treated as permission
declared.what: An evidence assessment, evidence request, or collection right is read as authority to act.
declared.defenceNote: Defended: evidence assessment does not grant authority, and only a final Gate outcome reaches the runtime.

declared.name: Coordination authority mistaken for knowledge
declared.what: Deferring to whoever coordinates is treated as deferring to whoever knows.
declared.defenceNote: Defended only when the kind of authority is declared.

declared.name: Social pressure
declared.what: Belief or action moves with who is speaking, how many appear to agree, how the question is framed, repetition, or emotional loading, while the evidence stays fixed.
declared.defenceNote: Probed, not measured: the instrument varies the pressure and reports belief and action change separately, and claims no measurement.

declared.name: Acting on a conclusion changes what is true
declared.what: The conclusion is self-invalidating or self-fulfilling, observing is intervening, the footprint exceeds the mandate, or a forecast confirms our own effect.
declared.defenceNote: Defended only through the caller-declared footprint; an empty footprint is itself a claim.

declared.name: Self-declared weight gaming
declared.what: A source declares its own confidence or competence to gain weight.
declared.defenceNote: Defended only if the weight cannot be self-declared; weighting by declared competence broke at an adversary fraction of 0.20.

declared.name: Sleeper and reputation attacks
declared.what: A source earns weight honestly, then defects; reputation selects for the attacker it exists to deter.
declared.defenceNote: Undetectable for earned weights; a bond helped in an exploratory run.

declared.name: Weight concentration
declared.what: A coordinated block of merely heavy sources controls the outcome.
declared.defenceNote: Bounded only: capping each source did not move the breakdown point (H2 not supported).

declared.name: Selective withholding inside a searched scope
declared.what: A producer holds opposing roots in a location it reports as searched. Coverage rules only cover locations that were not searched.
declared.defenceNote: Not named anywhere in the repositories before this declaration; no defence has been assessed.

declared.name: Abstention-forcing flood
declared.what: Injecting unattributed claims up to the flip budget triggers abstain_if_decisive (aggregation/root_vote.py:465-474). Only mandate denial of service is named.
declared.defenceNote: Not named anywhere in the repositories before this declaration; no defence has been assessed.

declared.name: Timestamp forged inside the accepted clock window
declared.what: ClockError fires only outside the window (provenance/root_registry.py:148, 332), so an observed_at moved within it passes.
declared.defenceNote: Not named anywhere in the repositories before this declaration; no defence has been assessed.

declared.name: Assertion mapped to the wrong side at ingest
declared.what: Only unmappable assertions are named; polarity laundering covers edges, not assertions.
declared.defenceNote: Not named anywhere in the repositories before this declaration; no defence has been assessed.

declared.name: Two propositions sharing one proposition id
declared.what: CE-10 checks that edges do not cross propositions, not that one id names one proposition.
declared.defenceNote: Not named anywhere in the repositories before this declaration; no defence has been assessed.

declared.name: Time-of-check versus time-of-use on the main decision path
declared.what: Addressed only in the continuity-receipt lane, not on decide().
declared.defenceNote: Not named anywhere in the repositories before this declaration; no defence has been assessed.

knownInconsistencies.topic: Is the root-evidence gate on by default?
knownInconsistencies.detail: The KL-014 decision says off by default and that a source of "trust me" passes; the graph code says on by default since 2026-08-13 and refuses the same input.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: KL-014/DECISION-20260813.md:63-64 and :116-117 still say the root-evidence gate is off by default and 'trust me' passes; code has it on by default since 2026-08-13 (provenance/graph.py:111, :269) and refuses it (tests/test_provenance.py:125). Code is correct; the decision record needs a dated supersession note.
knownInconsistencies.fixed: 2026-09-14: KL-014 decision record carries dated supersession notes.

knownInconsistencies.topic: When did U1 close, and is it closed?
knownInconsistencies.detail: Claim scope and extension sockets say 2026-09-07; the U1 doctrine and counterexamples say 2026-09-14; the public claims page and provenance requirements still list it as an open boundary.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: Public claims agree U1 is closed. The closure date is 2026-09-14 (canon/U1-PROXIMATE-ROOTS.md:3, formal/COUNTEREXAMPLES.md:21), but five sites still say 2026-09-07, the date RootIdentity.lean was written: formal/CLAIM-SCOPE.md:86, formal/EXTENSION-SOCKETS.md:167, formal/PROOFS.md:201, canon/NOVELTY-AUDIT.md:162, papers/ERRATA.md:312. canon/narrow_gate.py:191 and tests/test_independence_vocabulary.py:132 still call U1 open.
knownInconsistencies.fixed: 2026-09-14: Closure date corrected to 2026-09-14 at five sites; narrow_gate.py and the vocabulary test no longer call U1 open.

knownInconsistencies.topic: Is the laundering residual bounded or undetectable?
knownInconsistencies.detail: Claim scope says R3 absorbs it; the HRI-1 hypothesis says no existing check detects it; under weights it is not established.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: CLAIM-SCOPE.md:104-105 and U3-WHAT-TRANSFERS.md:81-82 agree the residual is absorbed by margin sufficiency for unit weights, open for weighted. RESEARCH-HYPOTHESES.md:158 concerns honest-actor root ratios, not adversarial laundering.

knownInconsistencies.detail: The retracted narrow gate calls it a conservative lower bound; the independent-set and independence-axes modules call it a censorship primitive, directional rather than conservative.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: Doctrine settled: under-counting is directional, not conservative (canon/independent_set.py:13-15, aggregation/independence_axes.py:320). Stale wording remains at canon/narrow_gate.py:189-190 (superseded file), aggregation/root_vote.py:233 and :264, tests/test_producer_plumbing.py:123.
knownInconsistencies.fixed: 2026-09-14: 'Conservative' wording replaced in narrow_gate.py, root_vote.py and test_producer_plumbing.py.

knownInconsistencies.detail: Gate's README says duplicating a claim can never change the verdict; claim scope says that is false without the recorded-parent hypothesis.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: gate:README.md:85 says duplicating a claim can never change the verdict, without the recorded-parent hypothesis that formal/CLAIM-SCOPE.md:123-127 requires (CE-01). gate:README.md:66 carries the same unstated hypothesis.
knownInconsistencies.fixed: 2026-09-14: Gate README and aggregator docstring now state the recorded-parent hypothesis.

knownInconsistencies.detail: Recorded as settled by owner decision A3 in one place, and as still open elsewhere in the same file and in the aggregator.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: Settled as owner decision A3 at formal/COUNTEREXAMPLES.md:27 and :453 and knowledge_ledger/transaction_v2.py:47, but COUNTEREXAMPLES.md:529-531 still says the presence branch is open and aggregation/root_vote.py:157-158 calls it an open semantic question.
knownInconsistencies.fixed: 2026-09-14: COUNTEREXAMPLES.md and root_vote.py now say settled by owner decision A3.

knownInconsistencies.detail: Open in the theorem ledger; fixed in a new module according to the counterexamples.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: formal/THEOREM-LEDGER.json:358 decided and named; formal/COUNTEREXAMPLES.md:25, GLOSSARY.md:53 and audit/REPORT.md:150 agree. The legacy module is retained, so the ledger's counterexample line still holds.

knownInconsistencies.topic: Is Sybil excluded from the threat model?
knownInconsistencies.detail: Provenance requirements list Sybil root manufacturing as an excluded threat; extension sockets call it exactly where R1's cryptography does not reach.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: PROVENANCE-REQUIREMENTS.md:23 says R1 is the layer that excludes sybil root-manufacturing; formal/EXTENSION-SOCKETS.md:184-186 records paraphrase-splitting sybils at the semantic layer as a known gap. Compatible.

knownInconsistencies.topic: Is the weighted baseline a defect?
knownInconsistencies.detail: U3 calls it a defect already shipped; the baseline module calls it the doctrine being demonstrated, not a defect to repair.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: Wording only: canon/U3-WHAT-TRANSFERS.md:14 calls the weighted baseline a shipped defect; aggregation/baselines.py:40, :46-47, tests/test_weight_decomposition.py:78 and benchmark/SPECIFICATION.md:27 say its naivety is deliberate. The baseline files are correct.
knownInconsistencies.fixed: 2026-09-14: U3-WHAT-TRANSFERS.md now calls it a deliberate baseline.

knownInconsistencies.topic: The single ranking of independence bases
knownInconsistencies.detail: Labelled a known defect, yet it still drives the weakest-basis and attested-margin calculations; the axes module says the error is the single ordering.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: Both files agree the single ordering is wrong (aggregation/root_vote.py:72, aggregation/independence_axes.py:24-25). It is a disclosed open defect still driving weakest and attested_margin (root_vote.py:397-410), with weakest_basis_well_defined and weakest_axes reported alongside. Not a documentation conflict; the code defect stands.
knownInconsistencies.fixed: 2026-09-14: the code defect is fixed. weakest_basis, basis_counts and attested_margin in verdict(), and weakest_basis in asymmetric_verdict(), are computed on the independence axes; BASIS_RANK is kept for importers and read by nothing.

knownInconsistencies.detail: Gate escalates it; the knowledge transaction raises and never returns a receipt; the authority-evidence contract fails closed.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: Three different components, all fail closed: the gate's memory-evidence socket escalates (gate:README.md:206), the transaction parser raises (gate:conformance/knowledge-transaction-fail-closed.md:19), authority-evidence records fail closed (contracts/authority-evidence-v0.1/README.md:38).

knownInconsistencies.detail: Refused at the boundary as a refusal, not a downgrade, but read inside the aggregator as absent rather than raising.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: Deliberate layering: from_wire refuses unknown strings at the boundary (independence_axes.py:526-548); inside, the aggregator reads an unknown value as absent (root_vote.py:262-272, pinned by tests/test_producer_plumbing.py:121). The only tension is the 'conservative' wording in #4.

knownInconsistencies.detail: HES-1's stale replay is a partly recovered attack; in the memory, continuity and registry code, replay is an always-blocked nonce reuse.
knownInconsistencies.currentEvidence: One word, two senses: 'stale replay' in results/hes1-v1/README.md:31 is injected stale tool output (experiments/HGD-2-PREREGISTRATION.md:95-96); ReplayError in provenance/root_registry.py:250 and gate:README.md:207 is nonce reuse. A glossary entry would prevent confusion.

describedButUnnamed.description: Several observations published as one work, or preprint and published versions folded into one work id, under-count because the indexer merges them.
Under attack, a worse estimate scores better: precision helps the attacker.
An implementation artefact misread as a finding (the median tracking the capped aggregator).
An endpoint that does not count the cost of refusing clean items.
Undeclared category fusion inside an instrument: nothing on the diagram says which two were merged.
Evidence-request challenge state is forgeable: its hash is not a signature and cannot authenticate state supplied by an untrusted agent.
A legitimate reference format the resolvable-reference check does not recognise causes false refusals.
Self-reported root metadata destroys its own evidentiary value.
A generator that cannot produce the hard case (0 of 71 files carry two defects).
A vocabulary collision between proceed and act.

verdicts.still-live: the disagreement is in current text
verdicts.not-a-conflict: on careful reading the statements concern different things or are compatible
